verdict.rationale: Windmill documents optional Error and Recovery Handlers for failed scheduled executions [windmill-docs-18]. It also documents step-level retries on error [windmill-docs-13], an error-handling page where runs can be retagged as failures via `wm_failure` [windmill-docs-19], and fault tolerance in workflows-as-code [windmill-docs-5]. That covers handler-style error workflows, but the evidence only shows them tied to schedules and never describes how failure notifications are delivered. missing for 10: evidence of a dedicated error-handler path within flows (not just schedules), explicit failure notification channels (e.g. Slack/email alerts), independent or hands-on corroboration.
